steps.note: S2.4.1 asserts that a forward invocation adds x_S to y_S for arbitrary scratch values (quoting the lemma statement at 729) but never gives the net change (JV+RG)x or the restoring rows that make it independent of the scratch values.

S2.4.3.1 only says coefficients depend on intersection size and side wires cancel 'the unwanted ones'; the bit-case central coefficient |S cap T| mod 2, the cancelled intersection-one cases and the self coefficient one are not stated.
The complex-case central coefficient (|S cap T|-1)/2 and the side wires cancelling intersections zero and two appear nowhere in the plan.
S2.4.1 gives only the end result (X,Y)->(-Y,X) of 'three such stages' with scratch restored; it omits the middle inverse stage X<-X-Y and the intermediate states (x,y+x), (-y,y+x), (-y,x).
S2.4.3.2 says every edge joins comparable nondegenerate labels, but the per-edge orthogonal residuals and their dimensions (the residual table) are not given.
The side edge 2->5, t_X perp t_Y giving <t_X> in t_Y^perp and the complement <t_X,t_Y>^perp of dimension h-2, is not mentioned.

S2.4.3.2 states that center 3->4 is the only decreasing edge, losing h, and gives the absolute total Wm-2N+2L, but omits the telescoping (sources N, sinks Wm-N, signed Wm-2N) that derives it, so it asserts the result without the sub-step.
S2.4.3.5 uses an orthonormal basis of each residual but never argues that binary residuals are nondegenerate and nonalternating, or that alternating planes can be absorbed.
S2.4.3.3 states L_b/N=100/539 and L_c/N=101/539 and quotes line 1107.
The plan states both ratios are below 1/2 (S2.4.3.3), s_b=W_b m-N+2L_b<W_b m (S2.4.3.4) and the deficit N-2L_b>0 (S2.4.3.4.3).
The exact relative deficit eta_b=339/22587335000000 does not appear in the plan.
The exact relative deficit eta_c=73/19906842167500 does not appear in the plan.
S2.4.4 states that both deficits exceed 20*2^-50 and log m<20, so tau=sigma=1-2^-50 gives s/W<m^tau, quoting line 1341.
Additivity of weight mod 4 for orthogonal binary vectors and the resulting q_V-q_U=sum wt(v)[v.x] are not stated; S2.4.3.5 gives only the conclusion.
S2.4.3.5 names the kernel aI+bX_v but not the odd weight giving phase i^{eps[v.x]} or the identity H diag(1,-1) H = X that turns it into a translation kernel.

The plan states one kernel per residual basis vector (S2.4.3.5), each giving one tensored child (C^{+-1})^{tensor f} across the axes (S2.6.1.2), s_c in total (S2.6.1.3), which is the tensored-factor count in the plan's own notation.

The endpoint frames I and C^{tensor m}, the C^{-1} on the 27 coordinates of supp(u_a) repaired by Z_{a,k} and i^{27k}Z_{a,k}, and the negation of the X outputs are absent; S2.6.1.3 uses C^{-1}=-iZCZ only for inverse children.
S2.4.5.1 states the factorization A=E_1 Pi E_2 with a ones but not the elimination proof (topmost row's rightmost pivot, lower-triangular clearing, repetition on active indices).
The choice of a fixed odd prime avoiding every denominator, so that the identities specialize to Z/q^b with invertible triangular factors, is not in the plan.

The S2.4.5 motivation says lower-triangular changes cost O(V) because controlled shifts update later fields from earlier ones, but it omits the descending-physical-order update that keeps earlier coordinates at their original values; marked absent on that doubt.
S2.4.5.2 gives D_j<-D_j+H_i, one interchange, D_j<-H_i-D_j for each one of Pi: a interchanges in all.
The constants E=64(W+m+1)^3, B=s+E, nu, C_1, C_0 and their values nu=11, C_1=20 are not defined; S2.6.3.5 only names the guard width ceil(C_0 d^{C_1}).
The depth recurrence A(e)<=sA(e/m)+E, the leaf bound A(e)<=8e and the per-invocation count below E are absent; S2.6.3.5 asserts guard width o(p) without them.
The unrolling B^{k+1}<=B^2 d^nu, A(e)<=8B^2 d^{nu+1} and the total below C_0 d^{C_1} are not in the plan.

S2.6.3.5 quotes 'Choose eps C_1<1' and asserts exactness with guard width o(p), but not the depth-ell invariant (values in 2^{-(p+ell)}Z[i] of modulus <=2^ell) or the p+Delta fractional and Delta+3 integer bits.
S2.6.3.6 asserts unit-disk outputs with error below sqrt2 2^-p but not the reason, that every row of H has absolute row sum one, so disks are preserved.

summary: P07 states the fraction values and the rank-saving inequalities (L5, R1, R4), the per-basis-vector tensored kernel count (P3) and the one-interchange implementation of each one of Pi (M4). It states most other sub-steps only by their conclusions: the bank-exchange lemma, the residual budget's final formula, the factorization, and the guard width o(p). It omits the coefficient cases, the residual table, telescoping, the F2 basis argument, the phase derivation, the elimination proof, the prime choice, the exact eta values and all of the simultaneous-layer depth analysis. 5 of 26 present.
